rules.internal_optimization: Keep every input/output XY fixed; relocate only internal logical nodes. Logical layers describe dependency, not immutable physical rows. Permit X and Y changes, local reordering and coordinated connected-group moves. Preserve every logical node and edge. A smaller internal envelope or Manhattan sum is a proxy: accept only independently certified actual area/QCA Pareto gains.

proposal.rationale: Relocate the connected group {4,5,6,8,9} vertically down to y=21–29 to eliminate the long vertical detour on edge [0,9] and reduce congestion near y=23–25; move 4 and 5 to shared y=21 to enable direct horizontal fanin from inputs, and align 8 and 9 on x=24 to shorten vertical routing. Routing order prioritizes reconvergent fanin (4 and 5 before 8), then critical path edges ([0,9] first) and avoids late routing of high-congestion edges like [5,3].
